Why it works

Mom's mustard ribbed sweater is the anchor: the warmest, brightest color on the board, so the eye finds her first against bare November branches, and cream cords keep her light and easy to move in. The guys carry the earthy side: Dad's corduroy sport coat is the special piece he asked for without a sweater in sight, and Jack's olive cords and camel field jacket look relaxed and cool. Cream and oatmeal on the kids spread brightness around the group, with chambray and denim as one quiet cool note. No prints needed; corduroy, cable, waffle knit and suede bring the texture.
